raw_snippet: Nebius Group N.V. (the “Company”) entered into a securities purchase agreement (the “Securities Purchase Agreement”) with NVIDIA Corporation (the “Purchaser”). Pursuant to the Securities Purchase Agreement, the Company agreed to sell (the “Private Placement”) a pre-funded Class A ordinary shares purchase warrant (the “Warrant”) in a private placement for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $2 billion
note: Nvidia -> Nebius equity via a US$2B pre-funded warrant (21.07M shares, exercise price $0.0001), alongside a partnership for more than 5 GW of Nvidia systems by 2030. Nebius Form 6-K.
